name: GWO World Title
epitaph: Named, with a co-held GWO World Tag Team Title, by an in-fiction wrestler's own title-count promo inside another federation's broadcast (30 December 1997); not one document of GWO's own survives to carry a reign.

name: GWO World Tag Team Title
epitaph: Named alongside the GWO World Title by the same in-fiction title-count promo (30 December 1997); not one document of GWO's own survives to carry a reign.

name: GWO Gotham City Championship
epitaph: Named by the same in-fiction title-count promo (30 December 1997) as the second wrestler's own belt; not one document of GWO's own survives to carry a reign.
